FARM CASE 🌱🔎

Every Farm Has a Mystery… Can You Solve It?

FARM CASE is an interactive agricultural investigation game that helps farmers make smarter crop rotation decisions.

Players enter their farm details, including location, soil type, water source, and previous crops. They then explore an interactive map to collect clues about climate, water, vegetation, and soil using NASA Earth observation data.

With the help of AI, the game connects and analyzes these clues to compare different crop rotation strategies based on farm conditions.

At the end, FARM CASE presents a suggested three-year crop rotation plan, alternative options, and insights into water needs and potential risks.

By turning complex data into an engaging investigation, FARM CASE aims to support farmers, protect natural resources, and encourage more sustainable agriculture.

Collect the clues, solve the case, and create a better future for your farm!
details:
FARM CASE

FARM CASE is an interactive agricultural investigation game that turns farming challenges into mysteries and clues. It uses NASA data and AI to help farmers understand their farms and explore better crop rotation strategies for more sustainable agriculture.

WHO IT WORKS?

THE START Page

PROFILE PAGE

 farm information, including their name, location, and soil type. This information helps us understand the farm's conditions and supports the next investigation steps

COLLECT THE CLUES

In this stage, farmers explore their farm and collect important clues from different data sources, including weather, water, crop health, and soil information. These clues help build a clearer picture of the farm's conditions before moving to the AI investigation stage.

AI Investigation

The system connects climate, soil, crop, and water data to analyze farm conditions and compare suitable crop rotation options.

CASE SOLVED

 farm data and NASA climate information. It compares alternative plans, explains the reasons behind each suggestion, and highlights potential risks.

FARM DATA

AI Assistant

THE benefits 

FARM CASE contributes to building a more sustainable agricultural future by helping farmers better understand their farms and make informed decisions. It combines NASA data and AI to turn agricultural information into useful clues and solutions that support better crop rotation, protect soil health, conserve water, and promote sustainable farming for future generations. 🌱

What Makes It Special?

FARM CASE turns farming into an exciting mystery-solving adventure. Instead of simply receiving recommendations, farmers become investigators who explore their farms, collect clues, and connect evidence to uncover hidden challenges. By combining NASA data, AI, and interactive gameplay, FARM CASE creates a unique way to make agricultural decisions smarter, easier, and more engaging. 🧑‍🌾🔍

Tools & Technologies: FARM CASE was developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, Python, and FastAPI. It uses NASA POWER and NASA GIBS for Earth observation data, Google Gemini for AI-generated explanations, FAO agricultural references, GitHub for code management, and Pytest for testing.

Come join us in FARM CASE! 🔎🌱 Become a farm detective, collect clues, and discover solutions with us. Are you ready to start the adventure?
